# Kenney Space Shooter Remastered

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/space-shooter-remastered
- Author: Kenney
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal
- Usage: player ship, enemy ships, bosses, weapon modules, projectiles,
  energy pickups, and the tiled starfield used by the 2D portfolio game.

The original asset pack is stored outside the Unity project at:
`E:\CoSoftware\GameAssets\Kenney-Space-Shooter-Remastered`.

Selected PNG files are copied into `Assets/Resources/Polish` and keep their
original artwork. Runtime scripts handle orientation, tinting, scale, trails,
and tactical-grid presentation.
